description: Header file declaring functions for CUDA-based distributions in PyTorch's ATen library, specifically for kernels related to Poisson, Gamma, Binomial, Dirichlet, and standard gamma gradient computations.

methods.name: launch_poisson_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches CUDA kernel for Poisson distribution sampling.

methods.name: launch_gamma_kernel
methods.description: Launches CUDA kernel for Gamma distribution sampling.

methods.name: launch_binomial_cuda_kernel
methods.description: Launches CUDA kernel for Binomial distribution sampling.

methods.name: launch_dirichlet_kernel
methods.description: Launches CUDA kernel for Dirichlet distribution.

methods.name: launch_standard_gamma_grad_kernel
methods.description: Launches CUDA kernel for the gradient computation of the standard gamma distribution.

methods.name: launch_dirichlet_grad_kernel
methods.description: Launches CUDA kernel for the gradient of the Dirichlet distribution.
